	The Business Development &amp; Executive Assistant will support the growth, client development, and effective day-to-day administration of House of H Limited.
	The role combines business development, client relationship management, proposal and quotation preparation, executive support, and business administration.
	The position requires a proactive and organized individual who can work with limited supervision, build strong client relationships, follow through on assigned responsibilities, and contribute to putting effective systems and processes in place as the company grows.

	Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, reports, presentations, and other documents when required.

	Draft and respond to routine business correspondence, emails, letters, and other communications on behalf of management where appropriate.
	Assist management in establishing and maintaining simple, practical, and effective systems and processes for the business.
	Assist in documenting basic operating procedures, workflows, templates, and administrative processes.
	Assist in monitoring outstanding quotations, invoices, client payments, procurement requirements, and other administrative matters.
	Support the implementation of systems that improve accountability, efficiency, communication, and follow-through within the company.
	Identify gaps in existing processes and recommend practical improvements to management.
	Work closely with the interior design and project teams to understand project requirements and ensure that client needs are properly communicated.
	Coordinate the flow of information between clients, management, designers, vendors, and other relevant stakeholders.
	Assist with the preparation of company profiles, brochures, presentations, portfolios, social media content, and other marketing materials.
	Assist in identifying opportunities to improve House of H Limited&#39;s visibility and positioning within the market.
	Support participation in exhibitions, networking events, property-related events, and other business opportunities.
	Maintain accurate records and prepare simple reports on business development and administrative activities.


Experience / Qualifications


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Mass Communication, Real Estate, Interior Design, or a related discipline.
	1&ndash;3 years of relevant work experience in business development, sales, administration, executive assistance, customer relationship management, interior design, construction, real estate, or a similar environment.
	Experience working in an SME or fast-paced business environment will be an advantage.
	Basic understanding of proposal writing, quotation preparation, client engagement, and business development.
	Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
	Ability to prepare professional business documents and presentations.


Required Competencies &amp; Personal Attributes:


	Hardworking
	Proactive
	Organized
	Resourceful
	Thorough and reliable worker
	Self motivated
	Must be able to communicate in both written and verbal English
	Ability to work on own initiative with little supervision
	Teamwork and essential quality.


Benefits


	Competitive salary and commission structure.
	Career growth opportunities in a dynamic and expanding company.
	Exposure to high-profile real estate projects and developers.
	Supportive and innovative work environment.

        ElsaDave Consulting Limited - Our client, an Oil & Gas Company, is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Internal Control Officer

Job Location: Apapa, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Description
     

            
    




	Our client is seeking to fill the role of an Internal Control Offficer whose will be responsible for designing, implementing, monitoring, and evaluating the company’s internal control systems to safeguard assets, ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements, improve operational efficiency, and minimize the risk of errors, financial losses, fraud, etc.
	Applicants residing in Apapa or closer proximity is highly preferred.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and monitor internal control policies and procedures.
	Conduct periodic reviews of operational, financial, and administrative processes to ensure compliance.
	Perform routine and surprise audits of company operations, including cash, inventory, fuel stock, and fixed assets.
	Identify control weaknesses and recommend corrective actions.
	Monitor compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and statutory regulations.
	Review financial transactions to ensure accuracy, completeness, and proper authorization.
	Investigate suspected fraud, theft, or irregularities and prepare investigation reports.
	Monitor inventory movement and stock reconciliation.
	Ensure proper segregation of duties across business functions.
	Prepare internal control and audit reports for management.
	Follow up on the implementation of audit recommendations.
	Support risk assessment activities and develop risk mitigation plans.
	Liaise with external auditors and regulatory bodies during audits.
	Train employees on internal control policies and ethical business practices.
	Maintain confidentiality of sensitive company information.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Percentage of audit recommendations implemented.
	Reduction in financial losses due to fraud or control failures.
	Number of internal audits completed as scheduled.
	Compliance rate with company policies and procedures.
	Timeliness and accuracy of audit reports.
	Number of control breaches identified and resolved.
	Inventory reconciliation accuracy.
	Resolution time for reported control issues


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Quality Assurance Associate Job at Lily Hospitals Limited




        
    

        
        Lily Hospitals Limited, established since 1986 remains one of the foremost hospitals in Nigeria and within the South-South region of the country. It is the first private hospital in Nigeria to achieve ISO 9001:2000 quality management system certification from the Standards Organization of Nigeria (SON) and was also recently accredited with COHSASA (Council for Health Service Accreditation of Southern Africa) Certificate. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Quality Assurance Associate 
Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Associateto support the implementation and monitoring of quality systems, internal controls, and compliance frameworks across hospital operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct routine risk assessments and support implementation of mitigation actions.
	Monitor compliance with internal controls, SOPs, and regulatory standards.
	Perform internal process audits, spot checks, and compliance reviews.
	Support quality improvement initiatives across departments.
	Review incidents, complaints, and near-miss reports and support resolution tracking.
	Assist in development and review of policies, SOPs, and control frameworks.
	Monitor outsourced service performance and compliance.
	Conduct environmental, hygiene, and safety compliance checks.
	Support implementation of ISO, COHSASA, Kaizen, and DMAIC standards.
	Ensure compliance with NDPR and other applicable regulations.
	Support internal customer satisfaction surveys and reporting.
	Provide support in training staff on QA and internal control processes.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in any science related discipline.
	1-3 years of experience in quality assurance, internal control, audit, or healthcare compliance.
	Understanding of ISO standards and healthcare accreditation systems is an advantage.
	Strong analytical, documentation, and reporting skills.
	High attention to detail and integrity.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.


Why Join Us?


	Competitive remuneration package
	Exposure to international healthcare standards and compliance frameworks.
	Health Insurance Coverage
	Career growth in quality assurance and internal control.
	Supportive and multidisciplinary work environment.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV & credentials to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
